mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 9.0% signals a strengthening labor market, which typically precedes improved corporate earnings and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic strength, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate profits improve.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST are rising (MoM > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales (RSAFS) series indicates strong consumer demand, which typically supports corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising (MoM > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity, which typically precedes improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the Federal Reserve's policy rate hikes compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 550.0 (thousands of units) signals a strengthening housing market, which typically boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 550.0.
